items.Sentence: Wastewater treatment at the Facility consists of a rotating screen for removal of large particles,
Wastewater treatment at the Facility consists of ... an aerated grit unit,
The trickling filter is typically only used during the summer.

When the trickling filter is online, approximately twenty percent of the influent flow is diverted ... before combining with the remaining influent flow from the aerated grit unit and entering the aeration tanks.
Wastewater treatment at the Facility consists of ... clarifiers for separation of solids,
The effluent is partially chlorinated with the addition of sodium hypochlorite solution to maintain consistent compliance with the receiving water bacterial standards.
Waste sludge from activated sludge reactors is aerobically digested, dewatered in a centrifuge, and dried in sludge drying beds before being hauled to the Pebbly Beach Landfill.
